text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
Here are the QFL ticket numbers I found in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**: Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025 about gatehouse kiosk SMS bay alerts at the Eau Claire yard. Support patched it and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct. The same note also asks for the Eau Claire kiosk logs to be archived before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
2. **#4419**: Moss's undated "North cheat sheet". Thea logged it for gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. The cheat sheet also says it was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing.

Moss's other QFL notes (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in) don't include a ticket number.

Two things to check before the weekly notes go out:
- Marcus's 14 Jul 2025 Q2 wrap note (not Moss's) also lists "Ticket #4419", but describes it as Gate 3 printer lag. That doesn't match the scanner issue in Moss's cheat sheet, so one of them may be wrong.
- My search runs keyword-only (semantic search is off), so I can't rule out a ticket that's worded differently. I searched on "Quarrendon", "Thea Ramaswell" and "Q-Freight" and checked every match.
